behavior: Active foliage gleaner that plucks small insects and eggs from conifer needles and bark, sometimes hovering briefly; often joins mixed-species flocks outside the breeding season.
field_marks: Bright yellow crown bordered by black, with orange in adult males
Bold black-and-white facial stripes around dark eyes
Pale olive-gray upperparts and grayish-white underparts
Dark wings with a thin white wingbar and yellow-edged flight feathers
Rounded body, short wings, skinny tail, and slender dark legs with yellowish feet
habitat: Primarily coniferous forest, especially spruce and fir in boreal and montane settings; during migration and winter also uses mixed or deciduous woods, wetlands, shrublands, parks, and other wooded habitats.
